PENTARYN_TIES.notify.noTieHere: Nothing recorded between you and them.
PENTARYN_TIES.notify.alreadyPinned: {name}'s card is already up — you dragged it, so it closes with its ✕.
PENTARYN_TIES.notify.allUp: {name}: every card is already up — the rest are pinned.
PENTARYN_TIES.worn.hudTooltip: Worn — mark who is inside this body tonight (GM only)
PENTARYN_TIES.worn.title: Worn — {name}
PENTARYN_TIES.worn.byPlaceholder: who is inside — Ozmandius the Unmade
PENTARYN_TIES.worn.notePlaceholder: What the wearer is doing with this body tonight. GM-only on screen — but like tie notes, not a locked box.
PENTARYN_TIES.worn.notifySet: {name} is marked worn by {by} — this scene's token only.
PENTARYN_TIES.keybind.showHint: Hover your token (or select one) and press to get a card for everyone you know who is in sight — their token art, the word, their name, your notes. Press again to sweep them away. Drag a card to keep it: dragged cards stay put, stay wired to their token, and close only with their ✕.
PENTARYN_TIES.keybind.oneHint: One connection instead of the whole web. SELECT your own token, HOVER the person you're asking about, and press: you get that single card. Press again while still hovering them to close it, or move to somebody else to open theirs. Needs both — a selection for who is asking and a hover for who is being asked about.
PENTARYN_TIES.keybind.describeHint: Hover a token and press for a card with their art and their written description — who this person is, rather than who they know. Press again on the same person to close it, or move to somebody else to swap. GM only: it reads the actor's private biography, which is your prep, not the table's.
PENTARYN_TIES.settings.sheetTab: Show the Ties tab on actor sheets
PENTARYN_TIES.settings.sheetTabHint: Adds a Ties tab to actor sheets. The tab is written against the default dnd5e sheet; a module that replaces the sheet entirely may render it oddly or not at all. Turn this off if so — the header button opens the same editor anywhere.
PENTARYN_TIES.settings.playerAccess: Let players see their own ties
PENTARYN_TIES.settings.playerAccessHint: Players can show the ties of a character they own, and read and edit the Ties tab on that character's sheet — including its notes, which are their character's own. They only ever see their own connections, and only ones their token can actually see: walls and light are respected. Turn this off to make the whole feature GM-only again.
PENTARYN_TIES.settings.nearDistanceHint: Within this many squares a card simply sits over its token. Beyond it, a thin line is also drawn from you to them, so a card floating across the map still belongs to somebody.
PENTARYN_TIES.row.wordLabelPending: One word — pick who this tie is to first
PENTARYN_TIES.row.notesPending: Pick who this tie is to, and this is where the long version goes.
PENTARYN_TIES.dialog.title: Record a tie
PENTARYN_TIES.dialog.pickTargetFirst: Pick who this tie is to. The word and the notes are about them, so they wait for a name.
PENTARYN_TIES.dialog.noOwned: You have no character with a token on this scene, so there is no list to write on.
PENTARYN_TIES.dialog.cannotWrite: {a} is not yours to write on.
PENTARYN_TIES.keybind.addHint: Hover someone and press. The token you hover becomes the person the tie is TO, and you pick whose list it goes on — unless they are the only character you can write on, in which case it becomes the person the tie is FROM and you pick who it is to. Right-click cannot do this: Foundry only opens a token's HUD for its owner, so a player right-clicking an NPC gets nothing.
PENTARYN_TIES.hud.tie: Add or edit a tie with this token
PENTARYN_TIES.dialog.pickSourceFirst: Pick whose list this goes on. The word and the notes are written from their side.
PENTARYN_TIES.dialog.mirrorLinked: Blank — stays the same as above.
PENTARYN_TIES.dialog.mirrorDiverged: Written separately — yours no longer changes it.
PENTARYN_TIES.dialog.saveFailed: That tie could not be saved — see the console. Nothing was closed, so you can try again.
PENTARYN_TIES.dialog.sourceHint: Whose list this tie is written on — you can only pick characters you own
PENTARYN_TIES.notify.dialogUnavailable: The tie dialog could not be opened — see the console.
PENTARYN_TIES.reply.tip: {name} has written you down too — you are their “{word}”
PENTARYN_TIES.reply.heading: {name}'s side — what you are to them
PENTARYN_TIES.inbound.heading: On their sheets only
PENTARYN_TIES.inbound.hint: People who have written this character down without being written down back. This section is never shown to a player — to let one see a connection, write it on their own character's sheet.
PENTARYN_TIES.inbound.rowLabel: {name} — recorded on their sheet, not on this one
PENTARYN_TIES.inbound.rowTip: Written on {name}'s sheet. Click to read it.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.title: Known
PENTARYN_TIES.known.hint: What this character knows about the people and creatures they have met — in their own words. Written here, kept here.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.empty: Nothing written down yet. Add someone you have met, then write what you know about them.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.addHint: anyone this character could have met — or hover them on the map and press {key}
PENTARYN_TIES.known.notesPlaceholder: Your own entry on {name} — what they are, what they can do, what you would tell someone about to meet them.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.notesEmpty: Nothing written down about them yet.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.expandEdit: Click to open and write on this entry
PENTARYN_TIES.known.expandEditOf: {name} — open and write on this entry
PENTARYN_TIES.known.picker.title: Add to the known list
PENTARYN_TIES.known.picker.label: Who have you met?
PENTARYN_TIES.known.picker.empty: Nobody left to add — everyone you could name is already on this list.
PENTARYN_TIES.keybind.knownHint: Hover a creature or a person and press. Their page in your character's notebook opens — the Known tab on your sheet — started for you if you have never written about them before. Three tokens of the same goblin are one page. Whose notebook it is: the token you have selected, else the character you are assigned, else the only one you own here. A token you cannot see cannot be written down.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.notify.needCharacter: Select your character's token first — a notebook belongs to somebody.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.notify.needTarget: Hover whoever you want to write down.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.notify.fileFailed: That could not be written down — see the console. Nothing was changed.
PENTARYN_TIES.settings.holdDefault: Hold every reveal for my approval
PENTARYN_TIES.settings.holdDefaultHint: When a player's study check lands, park what they learned and ask you before it reaches their notebook — so a good roll can cue a scene instead of a paragraph appearing mid-sentence. There is no deny: the prompt's Later just leaves it pending, and it stays deliverable from game.pentaryn.ties.study.pending() for as long as you like. Individual creatures can override this either way.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.study.tip: Study this — a {skill} check to work out what a {name} actually is. One attempt, ever.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.study.spentTip: You have already worked out what this is.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.study.noGMTip: Nobody is running the game right now, so there is nobody to roll against.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.study.kindLine: Kind: {name} — what you work out about this goes on that page.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.study.dialogHint: Declare anything that helps or hinders. The result is the GM's to read.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.study.combat: Studying something in the middle of a fight costs {name} their action this turn. Roll it?
PENTARYN_TIES.known.study.derived.none: You place it, but nothing you could set down in words.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.study.derived.unknow: Nothing about it means anything to you.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.study.derived.noTrai: Nothing about it strikes you as proof against anything.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.study.holdMeta: Tier {tier} on a total of {total}. Deliver now, or leave it pending and hand it over when the scene arrives.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.study.kindTip: GM: point this creature at the world actor that is its kind, so studying it teaches the kind rather than the individual.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.study.kindHint: A named individual points at the plain creature they are one of — Grix at Goblin. Leave it as itself for a stock monster, which is its own kind.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.study.kindSelf: — itself; it is its own kind —
PENTARYN_TIES.known.study.notify.spent: You have already worked out what this is.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.study.notify.noConte: There is nothing here to work out.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.study.notify.noGM: Nobody is running the game right now — a check like this needs somebody to roll it against.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.study.notify.noKind: That actor no longer exists — the pointer was not set.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.granted.label: What you have learned
PENTARYN_TIES.authoring.heading: Authoring
PENTARYN_TIES.authoring.kindHintSelf: Studying this creature reads its own stat block. Point it at another actor to share one bestiary page across every copy.
PENTARYN_TIES.authoring.kindHintPointed: Studying this creature writes to the {kind} page — the one every {kind} shares.
PENTARYN_TIES.authoring.beliefsHint: Exactly what each character was told, kept so you do not have to remember it mid-scene. Held rolls wait here until you deliver them.
PENTARYN_TIES.authoring.beliefsEmpty: Nobody has studied this one yet.
PENTARYN_TIES.authoring.beliefSilent: Nothing was handed over — you have not authored this side of the row.
PENTARYN_TIES.authoring.resetKeeps: They keep everything they already learned, and their own notes are untouched. A new roll replaces what this one told them.
PENTARYN_TIES.lore.heading: What a check can reveal
PENTARYN_TIES.lore.plaintextWarning: Everything you write here reaches every client. Nothing goes in a row that would ruin the game if read with devtools.
PENTARYN_TIES.lore.empty: No rows yet. Add one and give it a name, a skill and a DC.
PENTARYN_TIES.lore.labelLabel: What they are trying to find out
PENTARYN_TIES.lore.holdTip: Hold the result until you deliver it, so you can play the moment out first.
PENTARYN_TIES.lore.textPlaceholder: The thing they learn if they make the DC.
PENTARYN_TIES.lore.missPlaceholder: Vague, or confidently wrong — your call.
PENTARYN_TIES.lore.missHint: Write this. With blind rolls, a row that says nothing on a failure lets the player read the silence as a failure — and one that lies keeps them honestly guessing.
PENTARYN_TIES.lore.leakWarn: No failure text: a player who fails this will be handed nothing, and can tell they failed.
PENTARYN_TIES.lore.removeBody: “{label}” will be gone. Anyone who already learned it keeps what they were told.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.lore.heading: There is more to find out
PENTARYN_TIES.known.lore.tip: Roll {skill} against DC {dc} to find out: {label}
PENTARYN_TIES.known.lore.notify.spent: You have already looked into that.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.study.holdSilent: Nothing to hand over — this side of the row is unauthored.
PENTARYN_TIES.attributes.title: Attributes
PENTARYN_TIES.attributes.gmHint: What this one belongs to. Some are worked out from the stat block; the rest you link yourself. Lore you write here is shared by every carrier.
PENTARYN_TIES.attributes.playerHint: What this character belongs to, and what you have learned about each.
PENTARYN_TIES.attributes.playerEmpty: You know nothing special about this one.
PENTARYN_TIES.attributes.derivedTip: Read from the stat block — not stored, so it follows any edit. Unlink to suppress it on this one.
PENTARYN_TIES.attributes.grantsAdvantage: Sharing this grants advantage on studying each other.
PENTARYN_TIES.attributes.unauthoredHint: Nothing is written about {title} yet. Write an entry and every carrier gets it at once.
PENTARYN_TIES.attributes.deleteBody: Everything written about {title} goes with it.
PENTARYN_TIES.attributes.deleteKeeps: Carriers keep the link and anyone already told keeps what they were told. Writing the entry again restores it.
PENTARYN_TIES.attributes.searchPlacehold: Link an attribute, or type a new name…
PENTARYN_TIES.attributes.collides: “{title}” already exists under that name ({id}). Pick it above, or add a number to mean a different one.
PENTARYN_TIES.attributes.noMatches: Nothing matches. Keep typing to create it.
PENTARYN_TIES.settings.advantageStacking: How this module combines advantage and disadvantage on the checks it makes. The 2024 rules cancel them out whenever both are present, however many there are.
PENTARYN_TIES.settings.advantageNet: Count them up, the majority wins
PENTARYN_TIES.known.inspect.spentThisRou: You have already taken a moment to look someone over this round.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.inspect.holdWho: {character} is looking {subject} over. Something is waiting on you.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.inspect.tip: Take a moment to look {name} over.
PENTARYN_TIES.keybind.inspect: Take a closer look at the hovered creature
PENTARYN_TIES.keybind.inspectHint: Hover anyone and press to look them over — the only thing that starts an identification check. Nothing is ever rolled automatically.
PENTARYN_TIES.attributes.worldHeading: What you know of the world
PENTARYN_TIES.attributes.worldHint: Places, groups and conditions this character has worked out or been told about. Knowing a place makes its people easier to read.
PENTARYN_TIES.attributes.worldEmpty: Nothing yet. Look people over and you will start to piece the world together.
PENTARYN_TIES.attributes.failedTip: They rolled and missed. They can never recognise this on sight — only be told about it.
PENTARYN_TIES.attributes.grantPlaceholde: Something they have learned, or a new name to create…
PENTARYN_TIES.attributes.grantParentsHin: Leave this on unless you mean it. Telling someone about a guild without telling them about its city means they know it exists but can never spot a member.
PENTARYN_TIES.attributes.ancestryBroken: This one belongs to something it is not marked as part of: {names}. Until that is fixed, nobody can work out the deeper memberships.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.study.notify.already: {character} already knows {kind} at least that well.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.study.releaseTip: Hand them what a check of this level would have found. Raises what they know; never lowers it.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.inspect.scope2: {name} gives a second stranger the once-over. People do notice being measured.
PENTARYN_TIES.known.inspect.scope3: {name} is looking people up and down.
PENTARYN_TIES.attributes.helpHint: Leave both quiet for anything nearly everyone has — help that applies to every roll stops meaning anything. Turn 'has to be worked out' off for things anyone can see.
